workflow.name: Instant Ad Banner Generator
workflow.description: Generates professional marketing banners from a LINE message: GPT optimizes a Japanese marketing prompt, submits to AI image generation (Nano Banana Pro / kie.ai), polls for completion, uploads to S3, and delivers the image via LINE reply.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI GPT used to optimize marketing prompts

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name for prompt optimization

LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: LINE channel access token for sending messages (mocked)

AWS_S3_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name for hosting generated banners (mocked)

KIE_API_KEY.description: kie.ai API key for Nano Banana Pro image generation (mocked)

workflow_steps.name: LINE Webhook
workflow_steps.description: Receive a text message from LINE user containing product/campaign details in Japanese

input.message: 商品名: プレミアムコーヒー / ターゲット: 30代ビジネスマン / キャッチコピー: 朝の一杯が、仕事を変える。

workflow_steps.name: Extract Line Data
workflow_steps.description: Parse LINE webhook body to extract replyToken, userId, and message text

workflow_steps.name: Extract Prompt Text
workflow_steps.description: Parse the GPT/Gemini response and extract the clean prompt string

workflow_steps.name: Submit to Nano Banana Pro
workflow_steps.description: Submit image generation task to kie.ai Nano Banana Pro (1:1, 2K, PNG)

workflow_steps.name: Upload to S3
workflow_steps.description: Upload the downloaded image to AWS S3 with public read access (mocked to local file)

workflow_steps.name: Send LINE Reply
workflow_steps.description: Send the S3-hosted banner image back to the LINE user via reply API
